department: Department of Earth, Environmental and Planetary Sciences

supervisor.value: Applicants are asked to contact professors before the deadline about research fit and openings.
supervisor.quote: Please contact professors ahead of the application deadline to discuss your interests, their research group's current projects and availability for new student recruits.

funding.value: Five years of guaranteed support (stipend, tuition remission, health-services fee and insurance subsidy) for incoming doctoral students.
funding.quote: Incoming doctoral students receive five years of guaranteed financial support, including a stipend, tuition remission, a health-services fee, and a health-insurance subsidy.

entry_route.value: Coursework is counted beyond the bachelor's degree, so you can apply with a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Ten to 12 courses beyond the bachelor's degree
